summary: Lamar Advertising Company filed an 8-K announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend of $1.65 per share on Class A and Class B common stock, payable September 30, 2026 to holders of record on September 21, 2026. The board also expects aggregate quarterly distributions for 2026 to total at least $6.50 per common share. This is a standard capital return declaration, not a special situation such as a tender offer or issuer repurchase. No unusual terms, one-time payments, or strategic actions are implicated. The filing includes the press release as Exhibit 99.1.
